finalists.label: Eosinophilic Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (EGPA)
finalists.why: Strong evidence from Anti-myeloperoxidase titer and intraepidermal and dermal perivascular neutrophilic infiltrate.

finalists.label: Vasculitis
finalists.why: Broad evidence including necrosis of vessel walls and Anti-myeloperoxidase titer.

finalists.label: Cutaneous Leukocytoclastic Vasculitis
finalists.why: Specific findings of intraepidermal and dermal perivascular neutrophilic infiltrate and necrosis of vessel walls.

frontier_selector.why: The high Anti-myeloperoxidase titer and specific histopathological findings decided the final comparison in favor of Eosinophilic Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (EGPA).
